review_questions: Independently assess whether ReviewRequest canonical integrity is verified before any provider invocation and whether an invalid or malformed request fails closed with no reviewer authority effect.
Assess whether the pre-invocation integrity repair can be bypassed through request mutation, trigger metadata, alternate platform transport, direct runner invocation, or stale request replay.

Assess whether the repaired platform candidate review runner preserves exact request ID, artifact commit, reviewer provider/model constraint, review class, and transport binding through execution and evidence ingestion.
Assess whether historical invalid ReviewRequest REV-MVP-SLICE4-INTEGRATION-001 remains non-promotable and cannot be upgraded by its returned PASS or by later corrected-review consensus.
Assess whether provider/API failures remain non-authoritative and retry semantics preserve exact-request binding without rewriting failed history.
Assess whether session-state/shared-memory continuity and product-review versus live-governance review routing remain separated so stale or misrouted metadata cannot silently authorize a transition.
Assess whether the new integrity workflow and regression tests actually exercise pre-provider rejection rather than only post-response validation.
Assess reviewer provenance and identity claims, including that authenticated provider API execution does not overclaim cryptographic remote-model identity.

Identify any remaining authority bypass, false-green path, request-integrity defect, TOCTOU/mutation gap, review-routing defect, provenance gap, or fail-open behavior introduced or left open by this repair.
Return an independent disposition without assuming or using the proposer conclusion.

required_review_dimensions.description: Canonical ReviewRequest integrity must be verified before provider invocation; invalid or malformed requests have no authority effect.
Verified request identity, bytes/semantics, artifact binding, and reviewer constraints cannot be changed or substituted between validation and provider invocation.
Review execution and evidence remain bound to the exact current ReviewRequest and reviewed candidate commit.
Historical invalid review evidence remains non-promotable even when its provider output claimed PASS.
Provider/API failure and retry behavior preserves failed history, exact-request binding, and no authority effect until valid evidence exists.
Product review and live-governance packet/review routing metadata cannot be confused to authorize the wrong transition.
Regression tests and CI exercise the actual pre-provider rejection mechanism, not merely post-response validation.
Provider API authentication and reviewer identity claims are accurately bounded and do not overclaim remote-model cryptographic identity.
Stale session/shared-memory state cannot override Git/evidence or silently advance the review/promotion frontier.
Adversarial search for remaining request-integrity, mutation, replay, routing, provenance, or fail-open authority bypasses.
